name: raindrop-reveal
description: 雨滴点击展开沉浸式画廊
interaction: Users click or tap on animated raindrops falling across the screen, causing each drop to burst open and reveal a hidden gallery image with a smooth ripple expansion. As more drops are opened, the images mosaic into an immersive, scroll-free gallery. The rain continues in the background, inviting users to keep discovering.
